detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #2 Boot Mode Selection. A mode selection should determine what the system actually starts. PH4NTXM selects its operating profile during boot. Linux-aligned, Windows-aligned, Lonewolf Tor Isolated. The startup service records that choice and activates the corresponding dependency chain before the session becomes operational. Normal modes prepare the Packet Transformation Engine with mode-aligned Firefox ESR, and Unbound. Lonewolf prepares its independent identity chain, Tor routing, and Tor Browser. The selected mode stays fixed for the session, giving later services a common reference for their configuration and readiness checks. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
